data.title: Quality Per Joule
data.subtitle: Energy cost of generative image models
data.description: Measured image quality gain per joule across AE, VAE, GAN, WGAN, and DDPM. When quality and energy are weighed together, the autoencoder outperforms the more complex families.
highlights: Compared AE, VAE, GAN, WGAN, and DDPM under identical training and sampling budgets.
Energy measured with CodeCarbon at both training and inference time.
Reported a quality-per-joule ratio rather than quality alone.
The simplest model — the autoencoder — wins once energy enters the objective.

data.title: Orion
data.subtitle: Local-first agentic assistant
data.description: A secure local assistant that executes agentic workflows from text and voice commands. An Electron and React desktop app provides the interface, while locally or remotely hosted LLMs drive a custom agentic workflow.
highlights: Runs entirely on the user's machine — no prompt or file leaves the device unless a remote model is explicitly configured.
Agentic workflow built on LangGraph, with tool calling routed through MCP.
Accepts both typed and spoken commands.
SQLite keeps conversation and task history local and inspectable.

data.title: EcoSync
data.subtitle: Waste management platform for Dhaka North City Corporation
data.description: Full-stack municipal platform with real-time vehicle tracking, an admin dashboard, user authentication, and a companion mobile app for community interaction.
highlights: Real-time vehicle tracking across the collection fleet.
Admin dashboard with live operational statistics.
Role-based authentication for citizens, staff, and administrators.
Companion React Native app for community reporting.
Designed to degrade gracefully on intermittent connections.

data.title: qCompiler
data.subtitle: Embeddable code-compilation API
data.description: Open-source Node.js library for building online and offline code compiler applications, supporting multiple languages behind a unified interface.
highlights: One interface across several language runtimes.
Works in both online and offline execution modes.
Published as an open-source library for other developers to embed.

highlights: Covers enrollment, attendance, examinations, and automated result processing.
